title: Sum-Capture Bounds for Multi-Round Even–Mansour
summary: Sum-capture analysis currently stops at two rounds; the open task is to control bad-transcript probability for more rounds, beginning with three.

formal_statement.body: For the $r$-round Even–Mansour cipher with independent permutations and identical round keys, extend the sum-capture analysis beyond two rounds to upper-bound the probability of bad transcripts. The first unresolved case is $r=3$; establishing the required bound there is the immediate target.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography involving multi-round Even–Mansour block ciphers and bad-transcript analysis.
parameters: r: the number of cipher rounds, with three rounds as the first unresolved case
scope.unresolved_remainder: Extend the sum-capture analysis beyond two rounds to upper-bound the probability of bad transcripts, beginning with the three-round case.

progress.summary: The source presents this as a difficult extension of its two-round analysis and reports that no sum-capture bound is known even for three rounds under independent permutations and identical round keys.
citation_labels: Shan Chen et al., Minimizing the Two-Round Even-Mansour Cipher
